reference: ash-style-ref.png: dense, coarse pixel dithering across nearly every surface (armor, flesh, fur), hard jagged silhouette edges, visible discrete pixel blocks even on curves, chunky visible grain in shadow gradients, grimy desaturated brown/rust/bone palette with sparse hot-orange glow accents — reads unmistakably as pixel art first, illustration second.

sheets.why: Same dense stippled dithering, hard-edged silhouettes, and chunky pixel grain as the reference; grimy rust/bone palette matches.
